description_en: Queries a specified historical version of a specified API definition
description_zh: 查询指定API的某一次历史发布版本的定义详情，即某一次历史发布时发布的API定义
name: DescribeApiHistory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique
parameters.help_zh: API分组ID，系统生成，全局唯一
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

RELEASE

TEST: the test environment

PRE: the pre-release environment
parameters.help_zh:
环境名称，取值为：

RELEASE：线上
TEST：测试
PRE：预发
parameters.name: stage_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies the version number that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的历史版本号
parameters.name: history_version
